headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: the AEW World Tag Team Titles changed hands as The Gunns vs. The Acclaimed battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.29 ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. The Gunns was challenging for gold for the very first time. With their father Billy Gunn refusing to get involved, Austin and Colten Gunn used the title belts and a distracted referee to dethrone The Acclaimed's 140-day reign.
On this day in 2025, Kyle Fletcher vs. Mark Briscoe closed out Collision, rated 8.62 ? an outstanding performance from both sides in a hard-fought men's division clash.
Back on this day in 2023, Bryan Danielson vs. Rush delivered a genuine showstealer on Dynamite, rated 8.97, on an outstanding Championship Fight Night '23 show that earned an overall rating of 8.14.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when The Elite vs. Top Flight & Fox fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.97 ? a strong outing.
On this day in 2025, Infantry & Taylor made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.14 ? a solid showing.

It was 2023 when MJF vs. Konosuke Takeshita met in an Eliminator Match, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 8.10 ? a real highlight of the night ? part of a stacked Championship Fight Night '23 card, rated 8.14 overall.
